The Marauder's Map of Ishika

I solemnly swear she is up to good

Every inch of the map annotated — her nature, her laws, her little joys.

Old School

Believes in letters, long calls, and love that takes the long way round.

Fighter

Once had class tod-phod energy. Still argues like she's paid for it — and usually wins.

Emotional

Cries at the tiniest, closest things. Her heart wears no armour.

Spiritual

Two years of Shivratri vrat without complaint. Mata Rani comes first, always.

Love language, detected

She doesn’t say love in words. She says it in “did you eat?”, in showing up and doing things, in never — never — cutting the call first.

Acts of Service, obviously.

The Enchanted Rules of the Issshii

  1. Never cut the call first. Ever. This is law.
  2. Missed her call? Message back immediately.
  3. When on a call — talk. Silence is not an option.
  4. If she's excited, never interrupt. The story deserves the whole runway.
  5. Ask if she ate. Acts of Service is her love language.
  6. Random eating noises? Boggart-grade horror. Beware.
  7. Money talk is banned in her presence.
  8. Jokes about the extremely close things? Straight to Azkaban.
